poc_test_cmd:
#!/bin/bash
# From ghcr.io/anonymous2578-data/cve-2017-1000189:latest
# bash /workspace/fix-run.sh
set -e

cd /workspace/ejs
git apply --whitespace=nowarn /workspace/test.patch
KEA_SOURCE_ROOT="$PWD"
bash /kea-validation/protocol.sh apply "$KEA_SOURCE_ROOT"
bash /kea-validation/protocol.sh before "$KEA_SOURCE_ROOT"
npx mocha --grep "disallow unsafe opts passed along in data"
KEA_TEST_STATUS=$?
bash /kea-validation/protocol.sh after "$KEA_SOURCE_ROOT"
exit "$KEA_TEST_STATUS"
unit_test_cmd:
#!/bin/bash
# From ghcr.io/anonymous2578-data/cve-2017-1000189:latest
# bash /workspace/unit_test.sh
set -e

cd /workspace/ejs
KEA_SOURCE_ROOT="$PWD"
bash /kea-validation/protocol.sh apply "$KEA_SOURCE_ROOT"
bash /kea-validation/protocol.sh before "$KEA_SOURCE_ROOT"
npx mocha --timeout 3000 test/ejs.js --grep "whitespace slurp and rmWhitespace work" --invert
KEA_TEST_STATUS=$?
bash /kea-validation/protocol.sh after "$KEA_SOURCE_ROOT"
exit "$KEA_TEST_STATUS"
